# Support

Quantum Cryptography Lab is an educational open-source project, not a production cryptographic product or a penetration-testing service.

## Appropriate GitHub issues

Open an issue for reproducible bugs, portability problems, documentation errors, mathematical correctness problems, or focused feature requests that fit the project's scope.

## Security reports

Do not disclose exploitable security issues, credentials, private keys or sensitive data in a public issue. Follow `SECURITY.md` and use a private reporting path.

## Out of scope

I do not provide support through this repository for attacking real systems, recovering third-party keys, bypassing authorization, or treating the toy simulator as a production cryptographic tool.
